2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Araria P.S. Case No. 968 of 2022,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. According to allegation, the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the informant in the year 2016.

It has been alleged that the petitioner and his family members have tortured the opposite party no. 2 physically and mentally for demand of dowry and ousted her from the matrimonial house for non-fulfillment of the demand of dowry.
It is alleged that the petitioner has solemnized second marriage.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3908 of 2025(8) dt.02-12-2025
He has further submitted that the petitioner is ready to keep the opposite party no. 2 with full dignity and honour.
He has also submitted that the petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 7,000/- per month as an interim maintenance to opposite party no. 2.

sentences.text:
Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Araria in connection with Araria P.S. Case No. 968 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C. with further condition that the petitioner shall pay Rs. 7,000/- per month as an interim maintenance to opposite party no.
2.
6. This interim maintenance shall be subject to adjustment, if any other court grants maintenance to the opposite party no. 2.
(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) Ranjeet/-
